CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pos.h166_advance_snapshot_revision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pos'
AS $function$
begin
 update pos.online_snapshot_revision set revision=revision+1 where singleton;
 return null;
end $function$
